long.text: Learn to shape clay into something worth keeping, and build a small collection of my own finds in the house.
long.reason: Clay is good and so are things I have claimed, and I mean to have both in one place.

steps.reason: Dusk is here, and the telescope is mine, so I will look at the sky through it and keep what I see.
The telescope is mine, and the claim should be on record.
Seeds that grow without permission still bother me, so I want to know more about them.
I have not settled the moon's colour, and a drawing might help me decide.
The lamp on the desk is mine, and I want the claim on record.

today.reason: Dusk has started, so the telescope comes first, and the reading and drawing I still owe will fill the rest of the evening.
